content_of_post_to_comment: I like to pick a random word to spark writing inspiration. Thumbing through the dictionary this morning to find one, I came upon the absolute worst page. What I saw was disgraceful, disgusting, dishonest, and disingenuous.
comment: Interesting how a dictionary page can reveal more than words—it can expose the categories we use to judge people. I wonder if the danger lies less in the words themselves and more in how easily we recognize them in others but overlook them in ourselves.
